+# Acceptance Criteria
+
+- AC1: Opening a copy of a database created with main's schema migrates it in place: the number of attempts is unchanged, every attempt has exactly one Review keyed by repository id, PR number and viewer (case-insensitive), rounds are numbered by first appearance of a base..head pair in creation order, a continuation joins its predecessor's round, `previous_run_id` links each attempt to the one it follows, and a second open changes nothing. · sensitive: failure-scenario [verify: exec `bun test src/review/desk-run-store.test.ts`]
+- AC2: One PR with three historical runs on three ranges is one Review with rounds 1–3; a new attempt (start, retry on the same range, continuation, new head) is assigned its Review and round when it is recorded. [verify: exec `bun test src/review/desk-run-store.test.ts`]
+- AC3: A read-only store on an unmigrated database still returns badges and active numbers, and SQL `attachBadges` stays equal to `localBadge` for every query condition, including the round of an outdated result. [verify: exec `bun test src/review/desk-run-store.test.ts src/review/board-badges.test.ts`]
+- AC4: `keryx review reviews --json` returns one summary per Review with state, freshness, rounds and latest findings; state and freshness follow the specification table, and a missing store returns an empty list without creating one. [verify: exec `bun test src/review/review-entity.test.ts src/commands/review-reviews.test.ts`]
+- AC5: The Desktop bridge builds `review reviews --json [--repo]` only for a reviews-only request and refuses any combination with other board modes. (Rust unit tests run in CI only; no local toolchain) [verify: judged]
+- AC6: The project tabs read Sessions, Flows, Reviews, Pull requests, Issues, Metaproject with shortcuts in that order, and the Reviews tab shows Reviews in the columns Running · Waiting on you · Behind · Published (· Closed when shown) with list view, search and filters. [verify: exec `sh -c 'cd apps/desktop && bun test src/reviews src/shell'`]
+- AC7: The Review panel shows the rounds timeline and the review interface (history, report, answer, publication, lifecycle); the Pull requests panel no longer contains it and offers "Open in Reviews" for a PR that has a Review. [verify: exec `sh -c 'cd apps/desktop && bun test src/reviews src/review'`]
+- AC8: The Reviews tab indicator lights for `needs_answer`, `ready` without a publication decision and `stopped`, and stays off otherwise; the Pull requests indicator no longer lights from a local review that waits on the user. · sensitive: mutation [verify: exec `sh -c 'cd apps/desktop && bun test src/reviews src/review'`]
+- AC9: The attention-set logic in `ReviewBoard.tsx` is unchanged, and every line changed in `needsViewerAttention` is pinned by a test (each one-line mutation fails at least one test). · sensitive: mutation [verify: judged]
+- AC10: The outdated-review action reads "New review round" and names the round it follows; F-024's text comparison is gone and the outdated note appears once. [verify: exec `sh -c 'cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review'`]
+- AC11: The migration run on a copy of the local working database keeps every attempt and assigns each to one Review. (operator database; counts recorded in the journal, no data committed) [verify: judged]
+- AC12: Desktop and root test suites, typecheck and lint pass; CI is green or every failure is explained. [verify: invariant `sh -c 'bun run typecheck && cd apps/desktop && bun test src && bunx tsc --noEmit'`]

+# Context
+
+Base: `origin/main` at `a5d1ab236` (stage 0 merged, Flow 516, PR #1294). Branch `feat/desktop-review-v2-stage2`.
+
+## Sources of truth
+
+- `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/prd.md` — R4 (rest), R8, R12.
+- `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/specification.md` — «Сущности», «Состояние Review», «Хранение», «Экраны → Reviews», «Контракты данных», acceptance 11 and 16.
+- `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/implementation-plan.md` v0.1.3 — stage 2 row, «Передача следующим этапам», «Что этап 0 оставил в коде», D1–D6.
+- Flow 516 package: `.metaproject/flows/516-2026-11-23-desktop-review-v2-stage0/` (journal, mutation list for the attention set).
+

+

+
+## Parallel stage 1 (PR #1300, branch `feat/desktop-review-v2-stage1`, not merged)
+
+Touches `ReviewBoard.tsx` (props, quick filters, grouping, focus, work row), `ReviewResults.tsx` (rewrites the card: removes the icon review action including "Review again", removes `secondaryNote`, adds `PrWorkRow`), `model.ts` (status/role lanes, quick filters, `laneReason`), `App.tsx`, `AppShell.tsx` (3 lines), `ProjectNavigation.dom.test.tsx`, `review.css`. It does not touch `ReviewDetail.tsx`, the store or the CLI. Stage 2 keeps its edits in those shared files to the minimum the stage needs; the expected conflicts are listed in the PR body.
+
+## Memory and constraints
+
+- `keryx` on PATH is an installed build, not the working tree (memory: stale-installed-keryx-binary). Exercise new CLI code with `bun src/cli.ts …` or tests.
+- No Rust toolchain on this Mac: `review.rs` changes are verified only by CI.
+- Agent conduct: no AI attribution, commits only at task boundaries by the orchestrator, no `git stash`, no `git add -A`.

+# Desktop Review v2 stage 2: Review entity, rounds and the Reviews tab
+
+## Problem
+
+Desktop stores every review attempt as an independent row in `runs.sqlite` (`src/review/desk-run-store.ts`). Attempts of one PR are not grouped, a run has no link to the run of the previous round (spec O12), and the whole review interface (history, publication, rules) lives inside the Pull requests panel. Until a Reviews tab exists, stage 0 lets a local review that waits on the user light the Pull requests tab indicator (deviation (b) of the implementation plan), and the outdated-review action keeps the interim label "Review again" (decision (d)).
+
+Source: `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/` — PRD R8, the rest of R4, R12; specification sections «Сущности», «Хранение», «Reviews», «Контракты данных»; implementation plan v0.1.3, stage 2 row and «Передача следующим этапам».
+
+## Expected outcome
+
+- Every attempt in `runs.sqlite` belongs to exactly one Review (`reviews` table, key repository id + PR number + viewer, D3) and carries its round number and the id of the attempt it follows (`review_id`, `round`, `previous_run_id`). Existing databases are migrated in place; new attempts are assigned when they are recorded.
+- A project tab **Reviews** (order Sessions, Flows, Reviews, Pull requests, Issues, Metaproject — D4) shows one card per Review with its own columns, list view, filters and a panel with the rounds and the review interface moved out of the Pull requests panel (history, report, publication), and the Review rules button.
+- The Reviews tab indicator lights for `needs_answer`, `ready` without a publication decision and `stopped`. The Pull requests indicator no longer lights from a local review (closes deviation (b)).
+- The outdated-review action is relabelled to say it starts a new round of the same Review (decision (d)); the update round itself is stage 3.
+- F-024 (`secondaryNote` text comparison) is gone.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- Update round, `keryx review advance`, `on_head_move` behaviour, publication variants for a moved head (stage 3). The `on_head_move` column is stored with default `ask` (D2) but nothing reads it yet.
+- Session-package registration and shared publication code (stage 4).
+- The PR card work row and its review link (stage 1, PR #1300); this flow exposes the round on the badge so stage 1's link can show it after both merge.
+- Persistent per-finding identity across rounds (`Finding` entity) beyond what round packages already record.

+## T5 · Store: Review, rounds and attempts (`src/review/desk-run-store.ts`, `desk-run-types.ts`, `board-badges.ts`, tests)
+
+Schema (created by the writable constructor, idempotent):
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
+  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo TEXT NOT NULL, pr INTEGER NOT NULL, viewer TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
+  closed_at TEXT, on_head_move TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ask' CHECK (on_head_move IN ('ask','follow','ignore')),
+  UNIQUE (repo, pr, viewer));
+-- runs gains, when missing (PRAGMA table_info): review_id TEXT, round INTEGER, previous_run_id TEXT
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds ON runs(review_id, round);
+```
+
+`repo` is the repository id, as in `runs.repo`. `viewer` keeps the NOCASE collation of `runs.viewer`, so `Me` and `me` are one Review (D3: the account is part of the key).
+
+Assignment rule — one function, used both for the migration of an existing database and after every insert (`requestAttempt`, `recordExisting`); it only touches rows with `review_id IS NULL`, so it is idempotent and never renumbers an assigned row. Unassigned rows are processed in `(json createdAt, rowid)` order:
+
+1. Review: the row of `reviews` for `(repo, pr, viewer)`, created with a random UUID when absent.
+2. Round and link:
+   - `continuation.previousId` names an assigned row of the same Review → that row's round; `previous_run_id` = `previousId`.
+   - else a row of the same Review already has the same `baseSha..headSha` → that round; `previous_run_id` = the newest attempt of that round (a retry).
+   - else a new round `max(round)+1` (1 for the first); `previous_run_id` = the newest attempt of the previous highest round, or NULL for round 1.
+3. The migration runs inside one immediate transaction in the writable constructor; the per-insert call runs inside the caller's transaction (`requestAttempt` is called inside the dispatch transaction; `recordExisting` gets its own `atomic`).
+
+A package imported later with an older `createdAt` gets the next round number instead of renumbering existing rounds: round numbers that were shown are never changed. This is recorded as a known limitation.
+
+Projection: `history()` and `decode()` add `reviewId`, `round`, `previousRunId` from the columns to each `DeskRun` (new optional fields in `desk-run-types.ts`); `save()` must not write them into `details`.
+
+Read-only stores (`readLocalBadges`, `readLocalActiveReviewNumbers`) open databases that may predate the migration: every query that reads the new columns checks `PRAGMA table_info(runs)` and substitutes `NULL` when they are absent. Read-only paths never migrate.

 Состояние выводится из последнего раунда и публикаций; отдельного ручного поля нет.
 
 | Состояние | Условие |
 |---|---|
 | `queued` | последний Attempt в очереди |
 | `running` | последний Attempt выполняется |
 | `needs_answer` | выполняющийся Attempt ждёт ответа пользователя |
 | `running` | также `cancelling` — до фактической остановки |
 | `stopped` | последний Attempt закончился как `failed` (включая прерванный, `recoverable`), `cancelled`, `blocked`, `budget`, `skipped` и у раунда нет принятых находок |
